says: The runner makes `refused` with Schema `make` from the envelope's writer key and the descriptor's name, both decoded only as strings, while `Reply` needs non-empty strings.
proof: In: the envelope's writer is decoded with `Writer` (`key` and `for` are `Schema.String`, next/packages/libfabrika/src/access/SessionManager.ts:26-29), and `process.name` comes from `SavedDescriptor` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/cloudflare/runtime.ts:162-168). Make: next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:3148 `SupervisorMsg.cases.refused.make({ seq, reply: { name: process.name, ..., by: input.envelope.by.key, for: input.envelope.by.for, ... } })`, whose `Reply` fields are `Schema.NonEmptyString` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/internal/reply.ts:9-19).
cost: A value that fails the made schema, from a Project answer or the stored descriptor, now dies as a defect in the runner's generator. Before #1619 the plain literal went into `send` or `complete`, whose `Effect.try` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Runner.ts:771-774) turned the supervisor's own make into a typed `bad_row`. Every producer today is fabrika's own code, so it takes version skew between objects or a corrupt row.
